label: DREAD
description: DREAD risk model — mean of five 0-10 factors.

metrics.label: Damage
metrics.description: How bad is an attack? (0 = none, 10 = catastrophic)

metrics.label: Reproducibility
metrics.description: How easy is it to reproduce the attack?

metrics.label: Exploitability
metrics.description: How much work is it to launch the attack?

metrics.label: Affected users
metrics.description: How many people will be impacted?

metrics.label: Discoverability
metrics.description: How easy is it to discover the threat?
